# Historic eight-film fixture

Archived unchanged from the IIIx adaptation baseline 817ef05 before the 16-film catalog migration. These camera JSON files are test inputs, not the active catalog. The adjacent original README, license and changelog apply to the data; they are intentionally retained unchanged so archived photo notices can be tested byte-for-byte. The source fit files referenced by the manifest remain in film_curves/upstream_gr3_fits. All eight IDs have newer numeric values in the active catalog.
